body:
Real scope correction found live: STATE_LOBBY is a flat 2D menu, not a walkable scene, so the northstar's 'physical trigger volume' framing didn't fit -- built the real equivalent, a new menu option (M). New STATE_MATCHMAKING + PACKET_QUEUE_STATUS packet for live 'X/7 queued' feedback. net_tick's PACKET_MATCH_FOUND now actually transitions app_state. Both files gcc-clean, all existing tests pass. Live-verified over real loopback UDP: solo status-ack+dedupe test and 7-way concurrent probe test, both confirming correct live counts and match-found delivery. Commit 85ed697. Phase 3 (MODE_SANDBOX damage suppression) is the last remaining phase.

⚓ ☃
title: S248-02 shipped: client-side matchmaking entry + live queue status (BP-LOBBY-001 Phase 2)
